name: pending_orders
title: Pending Sales Orders
description: Open order book for sales & planning teams.
rules:
1. Orders with status Open or Partially Dispatched only.
2. Pending Qty = Ordered Qty - Dispatched Qty; hide lines where Pending Qty <= 0.
3. Ageing in days from order date to today.
4. Flag orders older than 30 days as 'Delayed'.
output_format:
Columns: Order No | Order Date | Customer | Item/Size | Ordered (MT) | Dispatched (MT) | Pending (MT) | Age (days) | Status
Sort by Age descending. TOTAL for the three quantity columns.
Summary: total pending MT, number of delayed orders, top 3 customers by pending quantity.
